# Documentation Templates

Status: canonical index

Copy the smallest template that fits the work. Replace every bracketed field
before committing; active documents need an owner and a verification date.

- [`proposal.md`](proposal.md) for an unshipped, owned change.
- [`decision.md`](decision.md) for a durable choice and its consequences.
- [`runbook.md`](runbook.md) for a repeated operational procedure.
